title: Core: workflow engine — match triggers, schedule actions
description: src/youtrack_aitrack/engine/. WorkflowEngine.dispatch(event, workflows) finds workflows whose trigger matches, then executes their action graph respecting depends_on. Independent actions run in asyncio.gather. Run lifecycle: pending->running->done|failed. Per-action result captured in Context for downstream actions. on_failure / on_success hooks fire as appropriate. Engine is pure — adapters injected.
acceptance_criteria: Tests with mock adapters: single-action workflow runs end-to-end; parallel actions execute concurrently; depends_on respected; failure mid-graph triggers on_failure; success triggers on_success; final RunState set correctly.

title: Core: action type contracts and scaffolds (no I/O yet)
description: src/youtrack_aitrack/domain/actions/. Define Action Protocol (async execute(ctx)->ActionResult). Skeletons (no real I/O): AiReportAction (just prompt rendering + stub LLM call), YtCommentAction (logs to console), SetFieldAction (logs to console). Real adapter integration lands in epic-003. Each registered via decorator. Pure dependency injection — adapters passed in constructor, defaults to no-op stubs.
acceptance_criteria: Each action type instantiates with injected dependencies. execute() returns ActionResult with success/failure. Tests assert dependency injection works and stubs do not call real services.

title: Core: YAML loader and workflow validation
description: src/youtrack_aitrack/config/loader.py. Load workflow YAML from path. Validate via pydantic Workflow model. Resolve env var references in YAML strings (e.g. ${YOUTRACK_URL}). Aggregate validation errors with file path and line numbers where possible. Schema export: dump JSON Schema from pydantic model for future UI editor.
acceptance_criteria: Valid YAML loads to Workflow object. Invalid YAML raises with helpful message. Env vars expanded at load time. JSON Schema export round-trips. Tests cover happy + several failure modes.

title: Core: plugin registry (decorator-based) for triggers and actions
description: src/youtrack_aitrack/registry/. Two registries: trigger_registry, action_registry. Decorator @register_trigger('name') and @register_action('name') attaches class to registry by string key. Lookup raises clear error on unknown type. Explicit init module loads all known plugins (no auto-scan). Type-safe via Protocol.
acceptance_criteria: Registry rejects duplicate registrations. Lookup returns class. Unknown type raises with available-types listed in error. Tests cover registration, lookup, duplicate, unknown.

title: Core: trigger types — status_change and manual
description: src/youtrack_aitrack/domain/triggers/. Implement StatusChangeTrigger (matches IssueEvent on from_state/to_state with '*' wildcard). ManualTrigger (always matches when invoked via CLI run command). Both implement Protocol Trigger.matches(event)->bool. Register via decorator at module import.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests: status_change matches correct from/to combos including wildcards; manual always matches; non-matching events return False; both registered under expected names.

title: Core: pydantic models for Workflow, Trigger, Action, Context, Run
description: Define the domain language as pure pydantic v2 models in src/youtrack_aitrack/domain/. Workflow (name, trigger, actions[], on_failure, on_success, context). Trigger (base + discriminated union). Action (base + discriminated union with id, type, depends_on, output spec). Context (immutable: issue, branch, diff, accumulated outputs). RunState enum (pending/running/done/failed). IssueEvent (incoming YT event). ActionResult. No I/O, no logic — types only. Discriminated unions via pydantic Field(discriminator='type').
acceptance_criteria: All models import cleanly. Tests assert validation errors on bad payloads. Example workflow YAML round-trips through model + dump. mypy --strict passes.

title: Bootstrap: src-layout directory structure and gitignore
description: Create skeleton: src/youtrack_aitrack/{domain,engine,registry,adapters/{youtrack,git,llm,storage},config,cli}/__init__.py + tests/{unit,integration,fixtures}/__init__.py + workflows/ + prompts/. .gitignore comprehensive Python: .venv, __pycache__, *.egg-info, dist, build, .ruff_cache, .mypy_cache, .pytest_cache, .coverage, htmlcov, .env, .idea (PyCharm), .vscode (VS Code per-user), .youtrack-aitrack-state/. Keep existing .beads/, .dolt/, *.db, .beads-credential-key, .claude/. Remove PyCharm scaffold main.py. .env.example with placeholders + comments: YOUTRACK_URL, YOUTRACK_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, REPO_PATH, YOUTRACK_PROJECT.
acceptance_criteria: All directories present with __init__.py. .gitignore committed. .env.example committed with documenting comments per variable.

title: Bootstrap: ruff and mypy strict configuration
description: Configure ruff in pyproject.toml: line-length 100, select rule sets E/F/W/I/N/UP/B/A/C4/RUF, format-on-save compatible. Configure mypy --strict on src/ (no implicit Any, no untyped defs, disallow incomplete defs). Verify on empty scaffold.
acceptance_criteria: uv run ruff check, uv run ruff format --check, uv run mypy src all pass on empty scaffold.

title: Bootstrap: pyproject.toml with deps and uv setup
description: Foundation for all subsequent work. Create pyproject.toml: project metadata (name=youtrack-aitrack, Python 3.12+, MIT license), runtime deps (anthropic, httpx, typer, pydantic, pydantic-settings, pyyaml, jinja2, python-dotenv), dev deps (pytest, pytest-asyncio, pytest-mock, respx, ruff, mypy, pre-commit). CLI entry points youtrack-aitrack and yta alias. uv as build/dep manager.
acceptance_criteria: uv sync succeeds; uv.lock generated; uv run youtrack-aitrack --help and uv run yta --help return without error (even if stub commands).

title: CLI: workflows list and workflows validate subcommands
description:
src/youtrack_aitrack/cli/workflows.py. Typer sub-app exposing two subcommands:

'youtrack-aitrack workflows list' — read InstanceConfig, scan paths.workflows_dir for *.yaml, attempt load_workflow on each, print a table: name | trigger type | action count. On parse failure, print the file name and the first-line of the WorkflowParseError but continue. Always exits 0. Useful for discovery.

'youtrack-aitrack workflows validate' — same scan loop, but exits non-zero if ANY file fails to load. Quiet on success unless --verbose. Suitable for CI / pre-deploy hooks.

Both commands accept --config-dir <path> (precedence rules from issue 759) and resolve the workflows directory through InstanceConfig.workflows_path(config_dir).

Output formatting: use typer.echo with simple alignment, no Rich tables for now (keep dependencies tight; Rich isn't a project dep yet). Error lines prefixed with 'ERROR: <filename>: <message>'.

Tests: use tmp_path with two YAML files (one valid, one with a known parse error), assert list prints both with the error annotated and exits 0; assert validate exits 1 and names the broken file.
acceptance_criteria: With a config dir containing one valid workflow YAML and one invalid YAML, 'workflows list' prints both files (one with an error annotation) and exits 0. 'workflows validate' exits 1 and names the broken file. Both commands respect --config-dir, $YOUTRACK_AITRACK_HOME, and the default ~/.youtrack-aitrack/ in that precedence order. No real home directory accessed during tests.

title: CLI: init command scaffolds the config directory
description:
src/youtrack_aitrack/cli/init.py. Typer subcommand 'youtrack-aitrack init' that creates the config directory (default ~/.youtrack-aitrack/, overridable via $YOUTRACK_AITRACK_HOME) and populates it with: config.yaml (template referencing ${YOUTRACK_URL}, ${YOUTRACK_TOKEN}, ${YOUTRACK_PROJECT}, ${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}), .env.example (committed-friendly placeholder file listing required env-var names), workflows/ (empty, with .gitkeep), prompts/ (empty, with .gitkeep), runs/ (empty, with .gitkeep).

Idempotent: each file/directory check-and-skip individually. --force flag overwrites existing files. --config-dir <path> overrides the default location explicitly (precedence: --config-dir > $YOUTRACK_AITRACK_HOME > ~/.youtrack-aitrack).

cli/main.py gains a load_dotenv() call at startup (BEFORE any subcommand runs) that loads <config-dir>/.env if present. Use python-dotenv (already a project dep). Document this behaviour in the init template config.yaml comments.

config.yaml template uses the field structure from InstanceConfig (this issue depends on 3v8). default_model in template is 'claude-sonnet-4-6'; branch_pattern is '{task_id}-*'.

Acceptance criteria covered separately.
acceptance_criteria: Running 'youtrack-aitrack init' against a tmp_path produces a directory layout that load_instance_config can read once env vars are set. Re-running 'init' is a no-op (no files overwritten). 'init --force' rewrites the template files. $YOUTRACK_AITRACK_HOME overrides the default location. --config-dir overrides both. Tests use tmp_path and monkeypatched env, never the real home directory.
close_reason: Implemented init subcommand + config_dir resolver. Scaffolds config.yaml, .env.example, workflows/prompts/runs subdirs with .gitkeep. Idempotent with --force override. Root callback wires --config-dir flag and auto-loads <config-dir>/.env via python-dotenv. 13 tests cover precedence, idempotency, force, dotenv autoload, and round-trip with load_instance_config.

title: CLI: InstanceConfig pydantic model and loader
description:
src/youtrack_aitrack/config/instance.py. Pydantic model InstanceConfig with sections: youtrack (url, token, project), anthropic (api_key, default_model), paths (workflows_dir, prompts_dir, runs_dir — all relative to config dir), defaults (branch_pattern, poll_interval_seconds). Loader function load_instance_config(path, env=None) mirrors load_workflow: reads YAML, expands ${VAR} via the existing config.loader.expand_env, validates via pydantic, raises a typed error (InstanceConfigError) with file/line on failure. Default model literal: 'claude-sonnet-4-6'. Default branch_pattern: '{task_id}-*'. paths fields default to relative names ('workflows', 'prompts', 'runs') so a freshly-init'd config dir works without overrides.

Resolution helper on the model: instance.workflows_path(config_dir: Path) -> Path returns config_dir / paths.workflows_dir; same for prompts and runs. Keeps relative-path logic in one place.

Acceptance: valid YAML loads; missing required field raises InstanceConfigError with the missing path; env-var expansion works; tests cover happy path + 4 failure modes.
acceptance_criteria: Valid YAML loads to InstanceConfig. Required-field omission raises InstanceConfigError naming the missing field. Env-var ${VAR} expansion works in token/api_key fields. workflows_path()/prompts_path()/runs_path() helpers return the resolved Path. Tests: happy + missing required + env expansion + custom paths + invalid YAML.
close_reason: Implemented InstanceConfig model + load_instance_config in src/youtrack_aitrack/config/instance.py with full test coverage (8 tests, all acceptance criteria met).

title: Epic: CLI workflow administration
description:
Make the CLI useful before adapters land. Three tasks: (1) InstanceConfig pydantic model + loader for ~/.youtrack-aitrack/config.yaml, (2) 'init' subcommand that scaffolds the config directory, (3) 'workflows list' and 'workflows validate' subcommands that exercise config/loader.py against a config dir.

This epic does NOT touch adapters. No network, no LLM, no YouTrack auth. Output is purely: usable CLI commands that read configuration from disk and validate workflow YAML against the existing pydantic models. Locked design decisions are in bd memories under keyword 'cli-epic-002'.

title: Bootstrap: README, LICENSE (MIT), CONTRIBUTING
description: README.md: project mission (3 paragraphs), quickstart with uv tool install, link to CLAUDE.md for architecture, status: alpha. LICENSE: MIT, year 2026, author Lech Buszczynski. CONTRIBUTING.md: beads workflow summary, link to anti-drift rules in CLAUDE.md, PR/issue process.
acceptance_criteria: README has working quickstart commands. LICENSE present in repo root. CONTRIBUTING references CLAUDE.md.

title: Bootstrap: GitHub Actions CI for lint and tests
description: Create .github/workflows/ci.yml. Triggers: pull_request to main, push to main. Steps: actions/setup-python@v5 (3.12), install uv via official action or pip, uv sync, ruff check, ruff format --check, mypy src, pytest. Single Python version for now (3.12+).
acceptance_criteria: CI YAML valid (yamllint or actionlint). Workflow runs all gates on PR. Failing gate blocks merge.

title: Bootstrap: pre-commit hooks for lint, format, types
description: Install pre-commit dev dep. Create .pre-commit-config.yaml running ruff check, ruff format, mypy. Document install step (pre-commit install) in CONTRIBUTING.md.
acceptance_criteria: pre-commit install succeeds. Failing lint blocks a test commit. README/CONTRIBUTING documents the install step.

title: Enable branch protection / ruleset on main once repo is public
description: Branch protection (classic API and rulesets API) is blocked on free private repos with HTTP 403 'Upgrade to GitHub Pro or make this repository public.' The j1j acceptance criterion 'Failing gate blocks merge' is therefore satisfied only visually (PR UI shows red checks) until the repo is flipped to public or upgraded to Pro. When the repo goes public, run the gh api PUT to /repos/PanzerLlama/youtrack-aitrack/branches/main/protection (or POST a ruleset) requiring the 'Lint, types, tests' status context, with strict=true so branches must be up-to-date before merging. Verify with gh api /repos/PanzerLlama/youtrack-aitrack/branches/main/protection.

title: Domain: validate depends_on in on_success and on_failure groups
description: Workflow._check_depends_on_resolves currently only checks self.actions[*].depends_on. Specs in on_success and on_failure can declare depends_on values that are silently ignored at validation time and will not be honored by the engine. Either extend the validator across all groups (with action_ids drawn from main actions plus same-group ids) or reject depends_on outside the main actions list. Add tests covering both groups.
acceptance_criteria: Workflow construction with bogus depends_on in on_success or on_failure raises ValidationError. Tests cover the new rejections.

title: Tooling: scripts/verify-hooks.sh integrity check
description: The pre-commit framework chain lives in .beads/hooks/pre-commit below bd's BEGIN/END markers. If bd ever rewrites the file (major version bump, recovery), the integration could vanish silently. Add scripts/verify-hooks.sh that asserts 'uv run pre-commit run' is present in the hook. Wire into CI (j1j) and/or scripts/setup-dev.sh.
acceptance_criteria: verify-hooks.sh exits 0 when chain intact, non-zero with a clear error message when missing. Called from CI and from setup-dev.sh.

title: Tooling: scripts/setup-dev.sh and CONTRIBUTING quickstart
description: Fresh-clone onboarding currently requires trial-and-error: installing uv on PEP-668 systems via 'pip install --user --break-system-packages' is ugly and Ubuntu-specific. Add scripts/setup-dev.sh that installs uv via the official Astral installer (or pipx fallback), runs uv sync, verifies pre-commit hooks are wired (calls verify-hooks.sh), and runs gates as a smoke test. Document the entry point in CONTRIBUTING.md.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh checkout + ./scripts/setup-dev.sh produces a working dev environment with all gates passing on a stock Ubuntu 24+ machine without manual intervention.

title: Tooling: pin Python to 3.12 via .python-version
description: uv selects the latest available Python (3.13.5) while pyproject only requires >=3.12. CI and teammate machines may resolve to different minor versions, producing subtle typing, lint and stdlib behaviour drift. Pin to 3.12 (lowest supported) via .python-version so uv reproducibly resolves the same minor everywhere.
acceptance_criteria: .python-version present at repo root with content 3.12. uv sync recreates the venv with Python 3.12.x. All gates green on 3.12.

title: Tooling: portable pre-commit + bd hooks setup script
description: Current pre-commit framework integration is patched into .beads/hooks/pre-commit which is gitignored. Fresh clones get bd hooks via 'bd init' but lose our pre-commit chaining. Add scripts/install-hooks.sh that re-applies the integration, document in CONTRIBUTING.md (and check on dev setup). Optionally explore moving hooks to a tracked, project-owned dir referenced via core.hooksPath.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh checkout + ./scripts/install-hooks.sh produces a working pre-commit + bd hook chain. README/CONTRIBUTING reference the script.
close_reason: False alarm: .beads/hooks/* is already tracked in git, so the bd-hook chained pre-commit integration is portable across clones via the regular commit flow.

title: Tooling: track .beads/issues.jsonl in git
description: bd auto-exports issues to .beads/issues.jsonl on every state change but the file sits inside gitignored .beads/, producing repeated 'auto-export: git add failed' warnings. JSONL is the canonical shared-issue format intended to be versioned. Update .gitignore to ignore .beads/* except issues.jsonl, then track the existing export.
acceptance_criteria: bd close or update no longer prints 'auto-export: git add failed'. .beads/issues.jsonl is tracked in git; .beads/beads.db and other local state remain ignored.

value: epic-002 (CLI workflow administration) design decisions, locked 2026-05-09. (1) Config dir defaults to ~/.youtrack-aitrack/, overridable via env var $YOUTRACK_AITRACK_HOME, and via CLI flag --config-dir (precedence: --config-dir > $YOUTRACK_AITRACK_HOME > default). (2) Prompt paths in workflow YAML resolve relative to InstanceConfig.paths.prompts_dir, NOT relative to the workflow file. (3) Tokens and API keys live in config.yaml as ${VAR} expansions; init writes a .env.example template and cli/main.py auto-loads <config-dir>/.env via python-dotenv before any subcommand runs. (4) Default model in init template: 'claude-sonnet-4-6'. (5) init leaves workflows/ and prompts/ empty (no default workflow shipped). (6) Three issues in epic: 3v8 (InstanceConfig model + loader) -> 759 (init) and kay (workflows list/validate). 759 and kay both depend on 3v8. Epic dr1 closes when all three close.

Future epic candidates after epic-002 closes. (A) Adapters epic: AnthropicLLMClient (anthropic SDK is already a dep), JinjaPromptRenderer (jinja2 is already a dep), YouTrackClient (httpx, REST, custom fields, comments, polling cursor), GitDiffAdapter (subprocess git for branch resolution + diff extraction), JsonRunStore (persists RunReport + last-poll cursor under <config-dir>/runs/). Each is one beads issue, contract-tested with respx for HTTP and tmp_path for filesystem. (B) Reference workflow epic: workflows/ready-for-testing-audit.yaml + prompts/security_audit.md, prompts/pages_changed.md, prompts/qa_plan.md + one snapshot test per template (rendered output, no LLM call). Pure content; can land in parallel with adapters. (C) Final wiring: youtrack-aitrack run <issue-id> and youtrack-aitrack poll [--daemon] CLI subcommands — depends on adapters + reference workflow.
